doc_summary: a flyable player's fall: `native_player_flyable_fall(player, fall)` is heard on both sides when a player with mayfly lands, also as a passenger of a falling mount, at `Player.causeFallDamage`'s early return. Mods may change the fall distance and multiplier in turn, but as in NeoForge they change nothing: the player still takes no fall damage. Bundles that use it need `"hooks": @API:player_flyable_fall@`.
